description: This line plot illustrates the loss evolution across iterations for four different training configurations of the SepLLM model, comparing their convergence behavior. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, labeled “#Iteration”, and spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5,000. The y-axis represents the loss value, labeled “Loss”, and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 with grid lines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four distinct lines: a magenta solid line with circular markers for “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, a blue solid line with circular markers for “SepLLM (n=128)”, an orange solid line with circular markers for “SepLLM (n=64)”, and a red dashed horizontal line for “Vanilla before post-training”. At the start of training (around 95,000 iterations), all three SepLLM configurations begin with a loss near 3.0, while the vanilla baseline remains constant at approximately 2.4. The magenta line (SepLLM n=64, larger lr) shows the most rapid decline, reaching a final loss of about 2.25 at 125,000 iterations. The blue line (SepLLM n=128) declines more slowly, ending at approximately 2.35. The orange line (SepLLM n=64) follows a trajectory similar to the blue line but slightly higher, ending at around 2.38. The red dashed line remains flat at 2.4 throughout the entire iteration range, indicating no change in loss for the vanilla model.
